title: What Suborbital Rocket Travel Is
definition: Suborbital Rocket Travel: rocket flights between continents in an hour.
description:
Suborbital Rocket Travel: rocket flights between continents in an hour. This is Future Transport & Mobility at its most ambitious — reusable boosters research, rocket logistics engineering and passenger safety operations converging on a single goal: making rocket hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Transport & Mobility will decide port networks outcomes this century. Suborbital Rocket Travel is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working rocket hulls, the larger reusable boosters vision stalls, and with it, the rocket logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Suborbital Rocket Travel in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

t: Real Research Today: Suborbital Rocket Travel
title: Real Research Today: Suborbital Rocket Travel
definition: Today's documented research behind Suborbital Rocket Travel.
description:
The road to Suborbital Rocket Travel is already being paved. Autonomous shipping trials (Yara Birkeland, MAS) test crewless cargo vessels. SpaceX Starship targets fully reusable heavy lift, the prerequisite for point-to-point rocket travel.

Personal rapid transit (Heathrow ULTra) and gondola transit expand in cities worldwide. Together these programs form the reusable boosters foundation that Suborbital Rocket Travel will build on — the rocket logistics results, the passenger safety methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as rocket logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Suborbital Rocket Travel
definition: Estimates Suborbital Rocket Travel readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Suborbital Rocket Travel components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a rocket hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Suborbital Rocket Travel Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Suborbital Rocket Travel operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Suborbital Rocket Travel installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 14090 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where reusable boosters monitoring, rocket logistics redundancy, or passenger safety maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Suborbital Rocket Travel Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Suborbital Rocket Travel: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Suborbital Rocket Travel — rocket flights between continents in an hour.

Phase 1 — Prove (reusable boosters): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (rocket logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (passenger safety): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (port networks): rocket hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and travel-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
